title: mob_duplication
description: Ready for some real chaos? This data pack doubles the madness in your Minecraft world! Now, every time you attack a mob, it splits into two absolutely identical copies.
body: Ready for some real chaos? This data pack doubles the madness in your Minecraft world! Now, every time you attack a mob, it splits into two absolutely identical copies. Can you survive in a world where every enemy becomes a whole army? A great challenge for hardcore players and streamers!
